summary: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing an extraordinary report regarding resolutions passed at its 102nd Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 26, 2026. The filing reports the election of 11 directors, each approved by over 90% of votes cast. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder meeting results. No deal terms or financial parameters are present.
